question.text: Parallel Structure can be expensive for investors because:

answer.text: Each Offshore Fund has its own Investment Manager charging management/performance fees

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.1.3, Parallel Structure has offshore IM layer + domestic IM layer = higher aggregate fees. The Trap: Other options incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Important trade-off to explain to HNI clients. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Recommend Parallel only when offshore investors need jurisdiction-specific tax treatment.
